backend_matrix.reason: Graph semantics are backend-neutral; numerical qualification remains lane- and operator-specific.
No graph contract promotes an unqualified FEM GPU interaction.
FDM mask resolution is defined, while cross-backend production parity remains open.
Capability must be resolved by the planner and cannot be inferred from authored scope.
